acceptance: release-prep runs uv lock for every project lock it versions, or release-check names the stale lock before CI; release-prep either curates or fails early with the count and the limit. A test covers both.
description: For 0.5.0rc3 prep (PR #3882, since closed in favor of #3902) release-prep did not update _project/sql-translation-ml/uv.lock (benchbox stayed 0.5.0rc2), so lint failed make uv-lock-revision-check. It also appended about 60 raw fragment bullets, taking the section to 105 bullets against the 45-bullet release-check limit, which needed manual curation.
